2608.04872.title: A-SR: Self-Evolving Agentic LLMs for Symbolic Regression via Hierarchical Coordination
2608.04872.paper_summary: Symbolic regression aims to discover closed-form equations from data, but existing LLM-guided methods often rely on a unified proposal loop that compresses heterogeneous search failures into a scalar score and a single prompt. We propose A-SR, a self-evolving agentic framework that shifts the control unit from expression edits to role-conditioned evidence views. A-SR coordinates formula discovery through routing among coordination protocols, an online evaluator-reward role policy, and state-routed process memory. During search, evaluator feedback characterizes reliability and productivity, updates role-level utilities, and routes elite motifs, failure traces, and validity diagnostics to different agents. The framework self-evolves at two timescales: within a run, it adapts the search process without updating LLM parameters; across runs, recorded trajectories can be distilled into open-source LLMs as role-conditioned proposal priors. Averaged over the four LSR-Synth scientific domains in LLM-SRBench, A-SR improves Acc@0.01 over baselines from 25.79% to 48.30% with Llama3.1-8B, while A-SR-LoRA improves the corresponding Qwen3-4B result from 24.58% to 38.29%. On four real-world scientific discovery tasks, A-SR obtains the best in-distribution or out-of-distribution normalized mean squared error on 7 of 8 reported metrics.
2608.04872.paper_summary_zh: 符號回歸旨在從數據中發現封閉形式的方程式，但現有的 LLM 指導方法通常依賴於一個統一的提案循環，將異質的搜索失敗壓縮為一個標量分數和一個單一的提示。<lb/>我們提出 A-SR，一個自我演化的代理框架，將控制單元從表達編輯轉移到角色條件的證據視圖。<lb/>A-SR 通過在協調協議之間路由、在線評估者-獎勵角色政策和狀態路由的過程記憶來協調公式發現。<lb/>在搜索過程中，評估者的反饋特徵化了可靠性和生產力，更新角色級別的效用，並將精英模式、失敗痕跡和有效性診斷路由到不同的代理。<lb/>該框架在兩個時間尺度上自我演化：在一次運行中，它在不更新 LLM 參數的情況下調整搜索過程；在多次運行中，記錄的軌跡可以被提煉為開源 LLM 作為角色條件的提案先驗。<lb/>在 LLM-SRBench 的四個 LSR-Synth 科學領域中，A-SR 將 Acc@0.01 在 Llama3.1-8B 上的基準從 25.79% 提高到 48.30%，而 A-SR-LoRA 將相應的 Qwen3-4B 結果從 24.58% 提高到 38.29%。<lb/>在四個現實世界的科學發現任務中，A-SR 在 8 個報告指標中獲得了 7 個的最佳內部分佈或外部分佈標準化均方誤差。
